sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Even lower daat is true, but it must be connected to upper daat to reveal its infinite source.

translations.translation: A)
And this is that also lower daat is truth, and nevertheless the connection of lower daat with upper daat is necessary
(see above section 4),
for the matter of the truth of lower daat is because its content
(in inwardness)
is the revelation of above, without end,
and this matter is revealed through its connection with upper daat.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The perfection of nature's governance is achieved when the revelation of above-nature is drawn into it.

translations.translation: And likewise regarding the governance of nature,
that although the governance of nature is also that "You are He who brought forth the ten tikkunim... to govern the worlds through them,"
nevertheless, the perfection of the governance of nature is when the revelation of above-nature is drawn into it,
for specifically through this it is revealed that the matter of "to govern the worlds through them" has its root in the aspect of "You."

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The connection of lower and upper daat, and nature with above-nature, is achieved through the revelation of the Essence above both, enabling the drawing of Atzmus into the world.

translations.translation: B)
And now, this that was explained above
(section 10)
that when it is felt in the two intellects
(of upper daat and lower daat)
that their content is to reveal the matters that are in Ein Sof
(which is above without end and below without limit)
the two intellects are one matter,
is in generality.
But in particularity,
even the matters of above without end and below without limit
(as they are in Ein Sof46)
are two matters.
And based on this,
in order for there to be the connection of lower daat with upper daat,
and likewise the connection of nature with above-nature,
it is through the revelation of the Essence that is above both of them.
And it can be said,
that this is what is stated in the maamar47
that the drawing of the revelation of above-nature into nature is through the drawing from the aspect of "You are One,"
even though the revelation of above-nature is also through the drawing of the aspect of "You is supreme,"
for the matter of above-nature that comes from the side of "You is supreme,"
above the chain of descent,
is not drawn into nature
(the chain of descent),
and the drawing of the revelation of above-nature into nature is through the drawing of the aspect of "You is One."
And this is also the reason for the necessity of the connection of the two matters of nature and above-nature,
for each of the two matters has its root in the light of Ein Sof,
and through the connection of the two matters is the drawing of the Awtsmoos.
That is,
that through this there is the possibility
(even from the side of the world)
that through avodah there will be in the world the drawing of the revelation of the Awtsmoos,
and through this the intention of the creation of the world
(nature)
is completed, that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have for Himself a dwelling place in the lower realms48.
